source_text: Περὶ τοῦ μὴ δεῖν τὰς χειροτονίας ἐπὶ παρουσίᾳ ἀκροωμένων γίνεσθαι. Ἐ ρ μ η ν ε ί α. Διορίζει ὁ παρών Κανών, ὅτι δέν πρέπει αἱ χειροτονίαι τῶν ἱερωμένων νά γίνωνται ἔμπροσθεν εἰς ἀκροωμένους (1). Ὅρᾳ καὶ τὸν λ΄. καὶ ξα΄. Ἀποστολικόν.
thought_title: Ordinations must not be held in the presence of hearers
orientation: The Council of Laodicea is issuing its canons; this section is a heading and interpretation of Canon 5, which forbids ordinations from taking place before hearers.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning the [matter] not [it] being necessary the ordinations in presence of hearers to happen. Interpretation. It determines the present Canon, that not [it] is proper the ordinations of the sacred [persons] to happen before in hearers (1). See also the 30th and 61st Apostolic [Canon].

choices.why: The brief lists Hearers as a cast member and the source does not define them as a technical class; 'hearers' preserves the literal sense of those listening.
The brief's cast includes bishops, presbyters, and deacons as clergy; 'clergy' renders the collective term naturally.
The council issues its own decrees; 'decrees' matches the legislative force of the canon.

choices.term: Ἐ ρ μ η ν ε ί α
choices.why: The spaced letters mark a heading; 'Interpretation' is the standard rendering for this explanatory section.

pass_b_english: Concerning the requirement that ordinations not take place in the presence of hearers. Interpretation. The present Canon decrees that the ordinations of the clergy must not take place in front of hearers. See also Apostolic Canons 30 and 61.

last_rejected.why: Source says 'it is not fitting/proper' (δέν πρέπει), not absolute prohibition 'must not'.
last_rejected.ruling: δέν πρέπει means 'must not/should not'; rendering as prohibition is within normal range, not a meaning change.
